recommendation: Separately preregister one gradient-free GPU/CPU inference comparison on the unsealed checkpoint and the already-consumed training cache.
fixed_scope: Use the first sixteen completed_observed groups in recorded cache order; bind checkpoint, cache, schema, source and expected device identity by SHA before reading numeric arrays. Do not replace groups after viewing output.
comparison: At most sixteen group-level GPU forwards, compare all candidates to the reloaded CPU model using atol 1e-4, rtol 1e-5 and exact per-group argmax. Report aggregate maximum error, mismatch counts and cleanup.
stop: Identity or device mismatch, nonfinite values, row budget or time limit stops the diagnostic without retry. No gradients, training updates, test inputs, new games or official steps.
interpretation: A reproduced mismatch is evidence about this checkpoint and selected inputs; a pass or failure cannot uniquely identify the previous ValueError. Do not use it as game-strength or model-promotion evidence.
privacy: Checkpoint, numeric cache, individual logits and device configuration remain local; publish only sanitized aggregates and hashes.
